title: Travel: John Lennon – Los Angeles to London | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from Los Angeles to London on 15 September 1970.

They had been in the US since 23 April, and their visa was extended three times. However, on 20 August the United States Immigration and Naturalization Service granted them a final extension to remain in the country until 15 September.

Lennon and Ono returned to London on TWA flight 760 from Los Angeles.
